title: Valid molecules, optimized trajectories
subtitle: Recent structural repair, noise and cooling experiments — alongside VAE latent optimization.

highlights.title: Sparse annealing reaches validity
highlights.body: The 50k cooling/ramp run ends valid and connected. 19/128 sampled endpoints are valid; the conditional 20k rescue was correctly skipped.

highlights.title: Chain + noise retains a valid endpoint
highlights.body: The structural weight 10 chain/noise arm ends valid and connected, but 0/128 samples are valid. Its start was already valid.

highlights.title: VAE finishes 50k latent updates
highlights.body: The frozen-decoder run starts and ends valid, with 50 distinct valid SMILES observed. Different settings and vocabulary prevent a causal head-to-head claim.

comparison_note: These are exploratory saved results. Contact, Boltz affinity and DBMol composite loss are different quantities. Validity means the recorded argmax sanitation result unless connectivity is explicitly stated; sampled validity is a separate endpoint test. Changing chemistry targets, coefficients and temperature means totals are not one fixed objective. VAE sample validity was not measured with the Mosaic protocol. One seed and different GPUs limit causal and runtime conclusions. None of these proxy scores establishes binding or activity.

runs.label: Sparse + cooling + noise
runs.context: Structural repair; chemistry 1→30 at 20k–30k, temperature 0.7→0.4, noise 0.4→0 by30k. Started sparse/random; 1,636 valid saved states.

runs.label: VAE latent + Protenix + structural repair
runs.context: Frozen epoch45 VAE; optimize 256D latent. Random latent decoded to a valid starting graph. Chemistry1→10, temperature0.7→0.4, noise 0.4→0; different element/charge vocabulary and latent step bound. 16,289/50,000 source states valid, 50 distinct valid SMILES. Not a matched direct-logit control.

runs.label: Chain + structural repair + noise
runs.context: Chemistry 10; noise 0.4→0 by20k. Chain/uniform initialization starts valid. 25,410 valid saved states; valid argmax does not imply robust samples.

runs.label: Chain + structural repair
runs.context: Chemistry 10, no step noise. Same chain/uniform initialization. 20,145 sanitized states; final graph is disconnected.

runs.label: Sparse + structural repair + noise
runs.context: Chemistry 10; noise 0.4→0 by20k. Sparse initialization; no valid saved argmax states.

runs.label: Sparse + structural repair
runs.context: Chemistry 10, no step noise. Sparse initialization; no valid saved argmax states.

runs.label: Structural repair · weight1
runs.context: Seed17 structural target builder. Compare first 20k with old repair weight1; extra 10k has no matched old-repair counterpart. GPU differs.

runs.context: Seed17 sparse baseline; original beam target search and chemistry weight1.

runs.context: Seed17 sparse baseline; original repair search with constant chemistry10.

runs.label: Protenix only
runs.context: No chemistry guidance. Entire saved continuation history starts at0; failed historical checks remain recorded.

runs.label: Protenix + delayed chemistry
runs.context: Original random initialization; delayed chemistry0.001→100. Compare with original constant-ratio noise arm, not as a matched annealing control.

runs.label: Protenix + delayed chemistry + noise
runs.context: Original random initialization and chemistry schedule; noise 0.4 relative to binding-only updates throughout. All resumed history included.

runs.label: DBMol composite objective
runs.context: Mosaic direct optimization using the Boltz composite loss, not the VAE. Completed 60k. Composite loss is not comparable to Protenix contact loss.
